outs.note: Lauri Markkanen (hand) was still out on Friday, Nov. 20, along with Jusuf Nurkic (foot) and Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), which leaves Utah without its starting frontcourt.

The show said Jaren Jackson Jr. is probably out at least another month; he has not played since October 26. The show said he will come back to a crowded Utah offense, with Darryn Peterson playing much better and Keyonte George taking a lot of shots.
